correctness.rationale: For n>=6,m>=3 a dissociation subset meets each clique fiber in at most two points. Proper 3-coloring of C_m with three disjoint label pairs realizes the 2m bound. Equality forces two points in every fiber; the within-fiber edge consumes the allowed induced degree, so adjacent label pairs must be disjoint, and that condition is sufficient. This establishes a bijection with length-m Kneser closed walks, not just a size bound. The incidence identity A=J+I-F^TF with FF^T=(n-2)I+J yields all eigenvalues d=C(n-2,2),3-n,1 of multiplicities 1,n-1,n(n-3)/2, proving the exact trace count for all parameters. Standalone exhaustive checks cover original products n=6,7 and m=3,4, independent trace DP n=6..10,m=3..12 and generic product tests. No numerical extrapolation is used.

originality.rationale: The new assertion is a complete classification and exact all-minima multiplicity for 3-path vertex covers of C_m square K_n (n>=6,m>=3), rather than a previously studied minimum cardinality. An exact bijection with Kneser closed walks, followed by the three-eigenvalue trace, produces the formula. value.rationale: The number and complete structure of minimum three-path covers are natural but not determined by their already-studied optimum cardinality. An explicit labelled infinite multiplicity formula on the full family C_m square K_n, n>=6,m>=3, exhibits a Kneser-homomorphism mechanism and exact three-eigenvalue dependence; it also gives the leading coefficient in the P3-cover enumerator and an exponential growth law. This is a full natural extremal enumeration, not an arbitrary tiny finite instance or a renamed preexisting size formula. Classical Kneser eigenvalues and the cardinality inequality are acknowledged, not represented as new.
